comments.author: Iago_Moor
comments.body:
@Steward and others : when dropping an item, there is a "cooling time" before anyone else can find it. Additionally, not all objects can be searched back, I am pretty sure maps aren't since otherwise scholars would be littered with them.

Some of my friends suspect that you cannot search the objects that you have dropped yourself, either, but we have no confirmation of this.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Actually, I have found many discarded scholar maps, usually in front of scholars inside of the archives (though sometimes elsewhere, like in front of banks, too). I even have one kicking around in my captain's bag at the moment, waiting to be used.

Additionally, you -can- rediscover objects you've dropped, at least in cities -- three times, I've found equipment I've discarded, and the game says something along the lines of, 'you have found the [object] dropped previously', or something like that. Not saying it works like that universally, mind... just mentioning what I've confirmed in my own time so far.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
You only stop getting treasure maps if you already have the map in question (stored in your captain's bag/bank/quarters or Astro storage), or if you've enabled Oxford skill Hide Treasure Maps.

Otherwise, it's a random percentage and you'll always have a chance to get that map as long as you meet the listed requirements. It's more likely that Sonia's problem had to do with having a higher skill rank; the higher your discovery skill rank, the more discovery/treasure maps you're eligible to get, and the less chance other ones might show up as a result. Some treasure maps also have a low chance of showing up to begin with, so that'd be an extra problematic factor to deal with.
